_provenance: Architecture metadata for the LSTM autoencoder in model.pt. AnomalyDetector.from_artifacts reads config.json when the checkpoint carries no 'lstm' block; model.pt has none, so without this file the loader silently builds the built-in defaults (hidden 32 / latent 16) and load_state_dict fails. Regenerated from configs/config.yaml, which matches model.pt (encoder weight_ih_l0 [512,52], latent_proj [256,64]).
